text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — RedRockSec just confirmed the assessment window: Apr 8-10. Need to finalize access window and RBAC for assessors.
Maria: thanks. do they need persistent creds or ephemeral access? we prefer ephemeral.
redrock-sec: Hi team — we'll use short-lived SSO tokens. Need one-time setup for our OIDC issuer + a few read-only roles. Also request for syslog export to a pre-signed S3 for 72h.
Tim: ok ephemeral + OIDC works. two questions: 1) which roles should we expose (prod-read-only vs logs-only)? 2) KMS: can we provide an encrypted bucket they can upload to, or they want us to upload exports?
Anita: For safety, give them a scoped 'assessor/logs-only' role that can't touch secrets or write configs. No prod-write. S3 upload for evidence is better — we generate a timeboxed presigned url from an upload bucket encrypted with a key we control.
Alex: +1. Also need a list of specific APIs/endpoints they need. we'll map to allowlist.
redrock-sec: We'll primarily need CloudWatch/Stackdriver logs (indexer), audit logs from API gateway, and access to a subset of KMS audit events. No key material needed.
Maria: KMS audit events — we can export CloudTrail events that mention KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Those are safe; do you also need key metadata (ARNs)?
redrock-sec: ARNs okay. We do not need to see KMS plaintext.
Tim: Ok. Action items: create assessor role, configure OIDC trust for redrock-sec, create presigned upload bucket encrypted with KMS key (alias/assessor-upload). Set retention 30d and lifecycle to delete after 30d.
Anita: Also add a tiny runbook: how to revoke assessor access early. Put it in the reading room.
Alex: who will be owner for onboarding? @Maria? also need to schedule a 30m handshake call with RedRock on Wed.
Maria: I can own onboarding. Wed works for handshake. I'll send calendar invite after we confirm a steward.
Oncall Ops: FYI — please mark the assessor window as a maintenance window in PagerDuty (no oncall escalation for automated test agents) 08:00-18:00 Apr 8-10 local-US-west.
security-bot: Reminder: create a ticket in SEC-OPS with attachments: role policy json, OIDC thumbprint, and presigned-URL expire policy. Template: https://redwood.internal/ops/pen-test-template
Tim: adding role policy draft snippet here:
```
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:DescribeLogGroups","logs:GetLogEvents","logs:FilterLogEvents"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:*:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/*"}, {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-assessor-uploads/*"} ] }
```
Maria: looks good. Please add explicit Deny for kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext? We should deny anything that could return plaintext.
Tim: added deny line and will post final to SEC-OPS ticket.
redrock-sec: One quick ask: during triage we may find medium-risk issues we want to see exp var logs. Can we get access to ephemeral application logs for flagged endpoints only?
Anita: We'll prepare a scoped log-forward path and a signed query token for specific traces. We'll not open global tracing. Provide a short list of endpoints we can forward.
Alex: On remediation tracking: I want a live spreadsheet (or tracker) where vendors can file findings, we assign engineers, and we track retest status. Preferably link back to Jira tickets.
Maria: let's use SEC-OPS ticket for intake and a shared Google sheet for quick triage. Columns: finding id, severity, component, assigned, remediation ETA, retest slot requested, status, evidence link.
Tim: I'll init the sheet and add columns, put the read-only link in SEC-OPS ticket and DM redrock-sec for the reporter link.
redrock-sec: Perfect. For retest coordination — we typically ask for a 24h retest window after a fix is marked Resolved. Can we guarantee a contact engineer to validate?
Anita: We'll require PR link + staging proof. Oncall Ops will coordinate a 2-hour validation slot per finding. If multiple findings, batch retest requests to reduce context switching.
Oncall Ops: noted. Please include expected SLA for retest: 48h for low, 24h for med, 8h for high after remediation marked ready.
Alex: Compliance question: do we need to enable extra audit logging (DB queries) for the test window? That could add cost but helpful.
Maria: we can flip DB slow-query logging to verbose for the window and revert. Put a cost note in the SEC-OPS ticket and get approval from finance if >$500 estimate.
Tim: I'll estimate. Also confirm: Do we want to rotate any keys pre/post assessment? I think rotate the assessor-upload key after the window.
Anita: Yes rotate alias/assessor-upload KMS key immediately after verification and revoke presigned urls.
redrock-sec: Thanks — we'll provide the final scope by EOD today. Looking forward to the handshake call Wed.
Alex: thanks everyone. Maria please send invite and set the SEC-OPS ticket link here when ready.
Maria: Will do. Ticket SEC-OPS-1127 created and sheet link posted. Invite sent to redrock-sec and owners. Closing thread for now, will update here with onboarding notes. :white_check_mark:
